q: 2024 年 6 月的总 GMV 是多少？
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(gmv), 2) AS gmv_june
FROM ydsh_dws.dws_trade_month
WHERE month = '2024-06'
LIMIT 200

q: 销量最高的前 5 个品类
sql:

FROM ydsh_ads.ads_category_topn
WHERE rank_no <= 5
ORDER BY rank_no
LIMIT 200

q: 每个城市卖了多少
sql:
SELECT s.city, CAST(ROUND(SUM(d.gmv), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS gmv
FROM ydsh_dws.dws_store_day d
JOIN ydsh_dwd.dim_store s ON d.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.city
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 200

q: 6 月份比 5 月份 GMV 涨了多少
sql:
SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2024-06' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) - 
              SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2024-05' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END)) / 
              SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2024-05' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate
FROM ydsh_dws.dws_trade_month
WHERE month IN ('2024-06', '2024-05')
LIMIT 200

q: 门店经营情况怎么样
sql:
SELECT s.store_name, SUM(d.gmv) AS gmv, SUM(d.order_cnt) AS order_cnt, SUM(d.user_cnt) AS user_cnt, CAST(ROUND(SUM(d.gmv) / SUM(d.order_cnt), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS aov
FROM ydsh_dws.dws_store_day d
JOIN ydsh_dwd.dim_store s ON d.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_name
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 200

q: 各支付方式的成交额占比
sql:
SELECT p.pay_name,
       CAST(ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS gmv,
       CAST(ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) / SUM(SUM(o.pay_amount)) OVER (), 4) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS gmv_ratio
FROM ydsh_dwd.dwd_order o
JOIN ydsh_dwd.dim_pay_type p ON o.pay_type_code = p.pay_code
GROUP BY p.pay_name
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 200

q: 取消了多少订单

q: 各订单状态的订单量
sql:
SELECT os.status_name,
       COUNT(1) AS order_cnt
FROM ydsh_dwd.dwd_order o
JOIN ydsh_dwd.dim_order_status os ON o.order_status_code = os.status_code
GROUP BY os.status_name
ORDER BY order_cnt DESC
LIMIT 200

q: 男女用户各贡献多少 GMV
sql:
SELECT u.gender, CAST(ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS gmv
FROM ydsh_dwd.dwd_order o
JOIN ydsh_dwd.dim_user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY u.gender
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 200
